origin.description: Alias of assertMatrix. Returns the value when it is a matrix. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.usage: assert_matrix(x, mode = NULL, any.missing = TRUE, all.missing = TRUE, min.rows = NULL, max.rows = NULL, min.cols = NULL, max.cols = NULL, nrows = NULL, ncols = NULL, row.names = NULL, col.names = NULL, null.ok = FALSE, .var.name = vname(x), add = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: mode
arguments.text: Storage mode of a matrix or array.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: all.missing
arguments.text: When false, a completely missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: .var.name
arguments.text: Name used in the assertion message.

arguments.name: add
arguments.text: Collection that stores the message instead of stopping.

origin.details: Alias of assertMatrix. Returns the value when it is a matrix. Otherwise it stops with the check message.
origin.value: The value when the check passes. Otherwise the check stops.
